arguments: the text after the skill name, or the request in the conversation
parallel_reads: make one `read` call for each file, all in the same message
start_search_agent: start the `explore` subagent with the `task` tool
start_subagents: start one `general` subagent for each with the `task` tool
delegate: Give this job to a `general` subagent with the `task` tool, so that you keep working while it reads.
skill_dir_note: `<skill-dir>` is the base directory of this skill. The `skill` tool gives it when the skill loads.
long_command: the `bash` tool and a timeout of at least 60 minutes
start_fixer: a `general` subagent with the `task` tool. opencode sets no effort for each subagent, thus the fixer uses the effort of the session
